status: Proposed navigation through existing public capabilities; not an implemented automated pipeline

stages.title: Explore
stages.question: What is worth investigating?
stages.description: Find the question worth pursuing and expose what is still unknown.
stages.output: Bounded question, unknowns and success criteria

stages.title: Curate
stages.question: Which sources can we inspect?
stages.description: Collect inspectable evidence and record what was and was not covered.
stages.output: Source manifest, exact spans, provenance and coverage limits

stages.title: Connect
stages.question: How do the claims fit together?
stages.description: Organize claims, relations and contradictions without erasing source identity.
stages.output: Connected claim/evidence map with contradiction and revision history

stages.title: Test
stages.question: What would challenge this conclusion?
stages.description: Try to falsify claims and check whether each conclusion is actually supported.
stages.output: Supported, contradicted and unknown claims; traps, nulls and limitations retained

stages.title: Create
stages.question: What should this become?
stages.description: Choose a form and turn tested material into a reviewable original artifact.
stages.output: Article, paper, talk, image, film or story with traceable evidence

stages.title: Refine
stages.question: What would make the work clearer?
stages.description: Improve clarity and form while preserving facts, citations, uncertainty and author control.
stages.output: Same-brief comparison, fidelity checks and human keep/undo

stages.title: Share
stages.question: What can someone else build on?
stages.description: Package a reproducible handoff and choose deliberately what to publish or retain.
stages.output: Reviewable handoff or explicitly approved publication; retained learning receipt
